verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents an interactive API reference with runnable "try it" examples, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec at any candidate path. The browser Playground tests models and features, which is an adjacent capability rather than an interactive API reference, so it earns no credit. Static quickstart code snippets are not runnable reference examples either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
